hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$hasClaudeDir = Test-Path '.claude'; $hasFiles = (Get-ChildItem -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -notin @('.gitignore','README.md') }).Count -gt 0; if (-not $hasClaudeDir -and -not $hasFiles) { Write-Output 'SYSTEM: Empty project folder detected. Use project-manager agent to initialize: ask project type and name, create README.md, .gitignore and doc/TODO.md. Create other folders only as files appear. Do NOT use scaffold skill.' }"
